verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a downloadable OpenAPI document at developers.notion.com/openapi.json: it returns HTTP 200 and contains the "openapi" key. An llms.txt index of the docs is also published. This spec covers the documented REST API surface for pages, databases, users and comments. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or versioning the OpenAPI spec, and evidence that the spec is complete (e.g. covering the webhooks and Agent APIs).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://developers.notion.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
